props.name: sheet
props.description:
Below 640px, open as a bottom sheet (Drawer) instead of a floating
panel. For panels with a list, a calendar or a form that don't fit
under a trigger on a phone. Not for popovers anchored to a text field
the user is typing in — the sheet would cover the field.

props.name: sheetClassName
props.description: Sheet mode: classes for the scrolling body that holds the content (default padding px-6 pt-2 pb-5).

props.name: sheetTitle
props.description: Sheet mode: visible title at the top of the sheet. Falls back to `aria-label` (screen readers only).
